job.title: Software Engineer II, Consumer
job.workplace: US remote, or hybrid in Boston or New York
job.pay_full: $104,000 – $213,000 a year base salary depending on pay zone (Zone A $133,000 – $213,000; Zone B $115,000 – $184,000; Zone C $104,000 – $166,000), plus equity and benefits

details.about: Toast's Consumer team builds Toast Local, the guest-facing digital dining product used by millions of restaurant-goers every day. This Software Engineer II joins a team of frontend, backend and native mobile engineers and builds features across every surface: backend services, the web, and the iOS and Android apps.
duties: Build guest-facing features end to end, from backend services to the web, iOS and Android clients
Pick up work wherever the team needs it and learn new parts of the stack
Break features into well-scoped, sequenced tasks and take them to production
Monitor what you ship, fix what breaks and improve the code you own
Work closely with product, design and engineers on other platforms
Use AI coding tools every day to ramp up on unfamiliar code and ship faster
needs: 2+ years of experience as a full-stack software engineer
Experience with at least one of React (TypeScript/JavaScript), Java/Kotlin or Swift
Willingness to work across backend, web, iOS and Android
Experience building or consuming GraphQL or REST APIs
Ownership of your work from build and test through shipping and monitoring
A passion for high-quality consumer experiences
details.benefits: Base salary depends on skills, experience and geographic pay zone: Zone A $133,000 – $213,000, Zone B $115,000 – $184,000, Zone C $104,000 – $166,000 a year. Total rewards also include cash compensation (overtime, bonus or commissions if eligible), equity and benefits.
notes: Locations: US (remote), Boston (hybrid) or New York (hybrid)
Toast asks candidates to complete interviews and assessments on their own, without real-time AI tools, recording or transcription bots unless told otherwise
Accommodations for the application or interview process: candidateaccommodations@toasttab.com
